system.description:
Caves, tunnels, and halls cut into the mountain, far from daylight. The air is cool and still, and a wrong step can drop a person into the dark. People here judge distance by echo and react before they think.

Talent: one Might die to d10, one Wit die to d10.

  • Stonebreaker. Your Blunt Techniques have +3 Pierce.
  • Cave Reflexes. +4 to Initiative rolls.
